title.narrative: EA 2026 - Crisis Appeal for Health, Emergency Support, and Survival Essentials

description.narrative:
Following the outbreak of violence in October 2023, the situation in Gaza has become one of the world’s worst humanitarian disasters. Infrastructure has been decimated, hospitals and schools destroyed, and tens of thousands killed or injured. Daily life is marked by constant trauma, loss of livelihoods, and widespread displacement. After the breakdown of a temporary ceasefire in early 2025, conditions deteriorated rapidly with widespread attacks and aid blockades that resulted in famine. Despite another ceasefire in October 2025, insufficient access has been given to humanitarian aid leaving families without sufficient food, clean water, or shelter. With health, protection, and basic services on the brink of collapse, the population faces extreme levels of suffering and a humanitarian crisis of historic proportions.
Against this backdrop, Caritas Jerusalem launched an Emergency Appeals in 2024, with support from CAFOD (PAL070), and 2025 to provide urgent assistance to some of the most vulnerable households in Gaza. The response focused on multi-purpose cash assistance (MPCA) to enable families to meet their most urgent needs, primary healthcare (PHC) to address critical medical gaps and sustain essential services, and mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) to help communities cope with the trauma of conflict and displacement. Building on this foundation, the 2026 Emergency Appeal will prioritise: MPCA, PHC, MHPSS, and WASH as well as winterisation plans, responding to ongoing needs as the crisis continues to affect vulnerable communities.
